title: Ethlete Icon Generator
description: Generates etIcon IconDefinitions and typed names from an installed SVG icon source. Auto-detects Font Awesome (pro, then free).

configPath.description: Path to the icons config JSON (relative to workspace root). Lists the icons/variants to generate.
configPath.x-prompt: Where is your icons config file?

outputPath.description: Where to write the generated IconDefinition constants (.ts).

typesOutputPath.description: Where to write the generated name/variant type augmentation (.d.ts). Defaults to 'et-icon-registry.d.ts' next to outputPath.

source.description: Icon source package to read SVGs from (expects a `svgs/<variant>/<name>.svg` layout). 'auto' detects Font Awesome pro then free.
